subject: Invitation to our Annual Company Party
body: Dear Team, You are cordially invited to our annual company party on Friday, December 10th. Join us for an evening of celebration, good food, and entertainment. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom of the Hilton Hotel from 7:00 PM onwards. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
